checks.message: The submitted site boundary is explicitly provisional and is not described as an official redline.
Three required key areas are present, non-overlapping and explicitly provisional.
Land-use polygons are generated as a shared-edge partition of the submitted site geometry.
Known spatial metrics are recomputed from the submitted GeoJSON layers; statutory controls remain unknown where source data is absent.
Primary and English visualization pages are offline HTML with local image references and no active network content.
Chinese and English proposal, report, visual, figure and drawing counterparts are present and mapped in manifest.json.
A3 and A0 Chinese and English PDFs contain non-empty pages generated from the evidence figures.
Every required chapter contains claim-adjacent evidence anchors and the structured matrices retain exhaustive coverage.
